name: break-first
description: A dev team for Claude Code that attacks its own code before attackers do. An orchestrator plans the task; a coder writes the code, a read-only reviewer checks it got better, not bigger, and a tester writes and runs unit tests. Then a red-team agent attacks the finished code locally, runs free scanners and proves every hole with an attack test; the coder fixes it and the proof is re-run.
